Maria (Design): Hey team — quick design review request. Dashboard card grid is wrapping oddly at ~920px. Buttons inside cards overflow into the action row and toasts are stacking under the header. Screenshot attached. Thoughts on adjusting spacing tokens vs changing breakpoints?
Kevin B: I can repro. At 920px the cards go 3->2 columns and the CTA group collapses. Maybe we reduce horizontal gap rather than break earlier.
Jo Ramos: Agreed — prefer token tweak if it doesn't create visual crowding. Which tokens are we thinking?
Maria (Design): Right now cards use `space-5` horizontal gap and `space-4` vertical. Proposal A: change horizontal to `space-4` at <= 1000px. Proposal B: keep gap, change breakpoint to force 2 columns at 880px.
Eli (Frontend): From implementation POV A is easier (single media query for token swap). B requires recalculating masonry logic. Also toasts: current stack uses `top: var(--header-height)` which overlaps at small sizes. We should switch to `calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-3))` for toast offset.
Sara (A11y): Two accessibility notes: keyboard focus order when a card collapses can jump users unexpectedly, and toasts are `aria-hidden` for screen readers in current impl. Toasts should use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` and not be aria-hidden.
Maria (Design): Good catch @Sara. I also noticed the primary CTA shifts visually when the action overflow menu appears. That feels like content shift — maybe we keep a reserved width for actions so the CTA doesn't move.
Kevin B: Could reserve `min-width` on the action container, e.g. `.card-actions { min-width: 84px }` then the CTA never reflows. Might cause truncation though.
Jo Ramos: If we reserve width, test truncation on long names. Can we collapse label to icon-only on small cards? Icon-only loses clarity. Maybe icon + tooltip?
Eli (Frontend): We could do icon-only at < 720px and full label >=720px. CSS:```@media (max-width: 720px){ .action-btn .label{display:none} .action-btn .icon{margin-right:0} }```This keeps DOM stable.
Maria (Design): I like that. Keep visual stability + preserve labels when possible. Also propose decreasing gap token only for medium widths so large screens unchanged.
Sara (A11y): Also keyboard: when label is hidden, ensure `aria-label` is present on the button. And focus ring must use high-contrast token (we had a regression where focus ring used `focus-weak` token).
Eli (Frontend): Noted — will add `aria-label` and enforce `--focus-color: var(--color-interactive-strong)`.
Kevin B: Small nit on toasts — stacking order currently LIFO top-first. For important alerts we prefer newest on top, but for info toasts maybe append at bottom. Any thoughts?
Maria (Design): Prefer newest on top for criticals, but default newest-bottom for ephemeral infos. We can add a toast attribute `data-priority="high"` and handle stacking differently.
design-bot: Reminder: design review checklist task created — https://redwood.internal/tasks/DR-412 (auto-generated). :white_check_mark:
Jo Ramos: Summary of action items I heard: 1) Token swap: `space-5` -> `space-4` at <=1000px (Eli to prototype) 2) Reserve min-width for action container OR icon-only collapse at <720px (Maria + Eli) 3) Toast offset -> `calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-3))` and add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` (Eli + Sara) 4) Focus token enforcement (Eli) 5) Add toast priority stacking (Kevin)
Maria (Design): Yep. Also I'll push a quick mock showing icon-only state and reserved action width so we can compare.
Sara (A11y): I'll run keyboard + screen reader check on the prototype once it's up.
Eli (Frontend): I'll drop a small PR with the CSS media query and toast offset later today.
Kevin B: :thumbsup: nice plan.
Maria (Design): Thanks all — aiming to ship this in the next sprint. If anyone sees a blocking edge case, ping me here.
Jo Ramos: One more micro-copy note: if we hide the label, tooltip should read full label + keyboard shortcut if present (e.g., "Run Query — K").
Eli (Frontend): Good call, will include shortcut in tooltip when available.
Maria (Design): ok closing — will post mocks and link the PR when available. :sparkles:
